messages:
Anya R: Quick checkpoint after the postmortem: we agreed on a short list of remediation tasks. Posting the condensed plan so owners can confirm timelines. Keep replies short so I can paste into the doc.

Samir: Go ahead.

Anya R: Plan: 
1) Reservation min headroom + tiered quota (goal: stop noisy tenants from consuming last 10%): owner @Samir, ticket RW-2040, target 10 business days.
2) Autoscaler hysteresis + scale-down grace for KV-backed jobs: owner @Priya K, ticket RW-2041, target next sprint.
3) Scheduler preemption policy tweak (soft-evict window + priority decay): owner @Jules, ticket RW-2042, target 7 days.
4) Emergency manual quota button + runbook step for oncall (short-term mitigation): owner @Anya R, ticket RW-2043, target 3 days.
5) Replay harness + regression tests using Mar11 trace: owner infra-sig, ticket RW-2044, target 21 days.

Priya K: Ill take RW-2041. Proposal: add a 120s cooldown after scale-up and ignore transient <15s spikes for scale-down. Simulation looks promising.

Jules: RW-2042 ack. My plan: add a 20s soft-evict grace so in-flight KV flushes complete, and decrement priority over 30s before hard preempt. Example flags Im testing: 
```
--evict-soft-window=20s
--priority-decay=30s
```
Will canary in staging today.

Samir: For RW-2040 Ill draft the reservation PR. Two knobs: guaranteed_headroom_pct and burstable_cap_pct. Initial proposal: guaranteed_headroom_pct=12, burstable_cap_pct=25 based on 95th percentile from last 6 incidents. Will attach percentile graphs.

Anya R: Short-term mitigation for customer impact: a manual per-tenant soft cap that reduces non-critical background jobs to 40% for 72h. Ill add the runbook step and feature-flag toggle in RW-2043.

incident-bot: Trace export ready: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/traces/2026-03-11-mar11-v2.tar.gz

Samir: Got trace link, thanks. Ill extract the tail latencies and include samples in RW-2040.

Priya K: FYI Ill add a derived metric "gpu_effective_headroom" and an alert if it <10% for >3m. Also a dashboard panel for recent evictions.

Jules: Noted. Also proposing a scheduler metric: pending_queue_age_seconds and a burn-rate alert when it grows faster than X tokens/min.

Anya R: Can everyone react with :white_check_mark: when theyve created their tickets so I can close the loop in the postmortem doc? Ill follow up with an owners sync in 48h.

Samir: :white_check_mark: (RW-2040 created)

Priya K: :white_check_mark: (RW-2041 created)

Jules: :white_check_mark: (RW-2042 created)

Anya R: Ill create RW-2043 and RW-2044 and ping infra-sig for the harness.

Samir: Suggestion: add a short customer-communication draft for affected tenants outlining expected improvements and temporary mitigations. I can start a doc.

Anya R: Good call. Add it to RW-2043 as a checklist.

Priya K: One more note: while we tune autoscaler, we should disable aggressive evictions for a rolling 24h window to avoid churn. Will add gating flag in RW-2041.

Anya R: Thanks everyone. Ill paste this into the follow-ups section of the postmortem and set a 48h checkpoint reminder.

incident-bot: Reminder set: gpu-postmortem-followup-checkin in 48h (1767865288).
